Question ID: Q076
Question: List work orders whose assigned technician is from the same region as the asset location.

rank_trace.sql:
SELECT w.work_order_id, w.status, w.scheduled_date  
   FROM work_orders w  
   JOIN assets a ON w.asset_id = a.asset_id  
   JOIN locations l ON a.location_id = l.location_id  
   JOIN technicians t ON w.assigned_technician_id = t.technician_id  
   WHERE t.home_region = l.region  
   ORDER BY w.work_order_id;

   WHERE t.home_region = l.region
